problem: The island-life slice needs a substantially larger and less uniform home world: residential space, river crossings, beach, forest, cave approach, shrubs and authored destinations must join the existing neighbors, requests and voyages without resetting saved homes or interfering with Pocket Club.
reuseDecision: Keep the persisted v1 core untouched and extend the deterministic voyage envelope. VoyageLayout owns river, bridge and resident-house geometry so walking, surfaces, rendering and map UI consume one source. Reuse shared proximity selection, pooled/instanced Three.js geometry, existing resident rigs, home/audio lifecycle and explicit state reducers. New shrubs and rocks are derived decorations; no second world save, router or dependency is introduced.
nonGoals: Copy Nintendo assets, text, characters, music or branding
Reset or move the player's persisted cottage, furniture or old core objects
Claim full island multiplayer, full NPC schedules, enterable caves or finished resident interiors in this slice
acceptance: Three reproducible regions have reachable docks and targets
The home exploration envelope has useful radius >= 32 and preserves every persisted core identifier
Three resident cottages, a residential street, forest, orchard, cave approach, river cascade and larger beach are authored landmarks
A meandering river and pond block movement except through the same two river bridges plus pond bridge that are rendered and classified as wood
Trees, shrubs, flowers and rocks are deterministically clustered by district and cannot block required paths, houses, discoveries or docks
Five requests validate resources/discoveries and award once; the forest quest requires the named forest and cave discoveries
Collectibles, discoveries, deliveries and travel survive reload
The notebook map renders the expanded coast, river, bridges and resident homes and computes discovery totals dynamically
Keyboard/touch dialogue, journal/map and boat travel work
Types, production build, unchanged bundle limits and browser evidence pass without gate relaxation
